# Cue 0.8.0 — Unit and currency conversion / 單位與幣值換算
## English
Cue 0.8.0 adds inline unit and currency conversion and fixes learned app choices that could remain behind a matching built-in command.
- **Conversions while typing:** enter `10m`, `5坪`, `25C`, or `100USD` to see up to three common conversions. Specify one target with `10m to ft` or `100USD to TWD`. Results share the launcher's nine-row limit with app and command matches; there is no separate conversion page or setting. - **Offline physical units:** length, area, mass, volume, temperature, time and speed are supported, including Taiwan's **坪**. Area uses the exact ratio `1 m² = 0.3025 坪`. English names and Traditional Chinese aliases are accepted. Select a result and press **Return**, or use its **Command+number**, to copy only the numeric value and close Cue. Paste with **Command+V** in the destination app; Cue does not paste automatically. - **Daily currency reference rates:** currency conversion requires **Settings → Network → Allow Cue to access the network**. ExchangeRate-API provides a daily table without an API key; Cue displays its date and source. These are indicative rates, not live market prices or bank quotes. Loading and retry states appear without blocking typing. Fresh rates are cached; expired rates are not used as current answers. Turning network access off cancels pending rate work and hides currency answers, including cached ones. Ordinary units continue working offline. - **Private conversion inputs:** Cue downloads a fixed USD-based table and converts locally; amounts, entered text and requested currencies are not sent to the provider. Normal connection information, including IP address, still reaches the provider. Conversion inputs and results are excluded from search learning. Typing alone does not change the clipboard; values explicitly copied follow Clipboard History's normal recording settings. - **Learned app choices can move ahead:** a successful choice for the same query can now promote an app above an incidental built-in command match. For example, choosing iTerm2 for `it` can move it ahead of the Traditional Chinese conversion command on the next invocation. Existing learning is preserved; explicitly configured exact command aliases still rank first. Ranking continues to use prepared in-memory scores, and background learning does not move the rows currently being selected.
See the [unit and currency guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/unit-conversion.md) and [adaptive search guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/performance-adaptive-search.md).
### Install or upgrade
[Download Cue 0.8.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.8.0/Cue-0.8.0-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.8.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
With Cue network access enabled, choose **Check for Updates…**, then **Install and Relaunch**. Or quit Cue, open the DMG, and drag **Cue.app** into **Applications**, replacing the old copy. Open the installed app and press **Option+Space**. Existing settings, clipboard history and search learning are preserved. Updating requires a writable installed location, not the read-only DMG. Automatic downloads and unattended installation remain disabled.
To build your own copy, install full **Xcode with Swift 6 or later**, open it once to complete its license and setup, quit Cue, then run:
```sh git clone https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue.git cd cue ./scripts/install-app.sh open "$HOME/Applications/Cue.app" ```
The optimized app stays installed at `~/Applications/Cue.app`. The first build downloads the pinned Sparkle dependency. To update that source build, quit Cue, run `git pull --ff-only` and `./scripts/install-app.sh` in the same repository, then reopen the installed app. Source builds default to Cue-owned networking and automatic update checks **off**; official DMGs default to **on**. Explicit saved choices are preserved. Currency conversion follows that network choice. Browser search has its own enabled-by-default switch in both builds. Installing an update offered by Cue replaces a source build with the published app. See the [source guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/building.md) and [network policy](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/network-policy.md).
### Installation and testing limits
The app is ad hoc-signed, **without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization**. If macOS blocks first launch, follow the app-specific [installation instructions](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/installation.md). Chinese text replacement still needs Accessibility permission for the installed copy; rebuilding or updating can invalidate an older grant.
Optimized checks cover core conversion logic, native conversion copying, currency-service freshness and cancellation, keyboard interaction, and adaptive search. Currency service checks use injected transport and isolated storage; a separate live check successfully downloaded the provider's fixed USD table. Local interface checks confirmed conversions and the learned `it` / iTerm2 ordering. These checks do not establish a full public update installation or cross-platform runtime compatibility.
The universal app targets **macOS 14+**, with Apple silicon and Intel binaries. Runtime verification is on **Apple silicon / macOS 27.0 / Xcode 27**. Intel, other macOS versions, first installation on another Mac, and a full public update installation remain unverified. System-action checks use substitutes; actual sleep, lock, display-off and logout/reboot startup cycles have not been verified for this release.
## 正體中文
Cue 0.8.0 加入主搜尋中的單位與幣值換算，並修正學習後的 App 選擇仍可能 固定排在符合的內建指令後面的問題。
- **打字即顯示換算：**輸入 `10m`、`5坪`、`25C` 或 `100USD`，即可看到最多 三種常用換算；用 `10m to ft` 或 `100USD to TWD` 指定一個目標。換算結果 與符合的 App、指令共用最多九列的限制，不需另一個換算頁面或額外設定。 - **一般單位完全離線：**支援長度、面積、質量、體積、溫度、時間與速度， 包含台灣的**坪**。面積採用精確比例 `1 平方公尺 = 0.3025 坪`，也接受 英文名稱與正體中文別名。選取結果後按 **Return**，或按對應的 **Command+數字**，只拷貝數值並收起 Cue；再到目標 App 按 **Command+V** 貼上，Cue 不會自動貼入。 - **每日幣值參考匯率：**幣值換算需要開啟**設定 → 網路 → 允許 Cue 自行 連網**。ExchangeRate-API 提供每日匯率表，不需 API 金鑰；Cue 顯示資料 日期與來源。這是參考匯率，不是即時行情或銀行報價。載入與重試狀態不會 阻擋打字；有效資料會快取，過期匯率不當成目前答案。關閉網路會取消 等待中的匯率工作，快取的幣值答案也會隱藏；一般單位仍可離線使用。 - **換算輸入留在本機：**Cue 下載固定的美元基準匯率表，再於本機換算， 不會向服務商送出金額、輸入文字或指定幣別；IP 位址等一般連線資訊仍會 傳給服務商。換算輸入與結果不加入搜尋學習。單純打字不會修改剪貼簿， 明確拷貝的數值依剪貼簿記錄原有設定處理。 - **學習後的 App 可往前排：**相同關鍵字的成功選擇，現在能讓 App 超過 碰巧符合的內建指令。例如用 `it` 成功開啟 iTerm2 後，下次叫出時可超過 正體中文轉換指令。原有學習紀錄會保留；明確設定的完整指令別名仍優先。 排序繼續使用記憶體中的分數，背景學習不會讓正在選取的列表突然跳動。
詳見[單位與幣值換算說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/unit-conversion.md) 及[搜尋習慣說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/performance-adaptive-search.md)。
### 安裝或升級
[下載 Cue 0.8.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.8.0/Cue-0.8.0-universal.dmg) · [檢查碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.8.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
允許 Cue 使用網路後，選擇**檢查更新⋯**，再依提示安裝並重新啟動（**Install and Relaunch**）；或先結束 Cue，開啟 DMG，將 **Cue.app** 拖進**應用程式**取代 舊版，再開啟安裝好的 App，按 **Option+Space**。原有設定、剪貼簿記錄與搜尋 學習資料都會保留。更新需要可寫入的安裝位置，不能直接在唯讀 DMG 中執行； 自動下載及無人操作安裝仍維持停用。
自行編譯需要內含 **Swift 6 以上的完整 Xcode**，先開啟完成授權與設定、結束 Cue，再執行：
```sh git clone https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue.git cd cue ./scripts/install-app.sh open "$HOME/Applications/Cue.app" ```
最佳化 App 會固定安裝至 `~/Applications/Cue.app`。首次建置下載固定版本的 Sparkle；更新自行建置版時，先結束 Cue，在同一份儲存庫執行 `git pull --ff-only` 與 `./scripts/install-app.sh`，再重新開啟已安裝的 App。自行建置版預設**關閉** Cue 自行連網與自動檢查更新，正式 DMG 預設**開啟**；明確儲存的選擇會保留， 幣值換算也遵守該網路選擇。兩種版本的瀏覽器搜尋皆有獨立、預設開啟的開關。 若從 Cue 安裝提供的更新，會將自行建置版換成發布版。詳見 [原始碼指引](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/building.md)與 [網路政策](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/network-policy.md)。
### 安裝與驗證限制
App 使用 ad hoc 簽章，**沒有 Developer ID 簽署，也未經 Apple 公證**。若 macOS 阻擋首次開啟，請依針對 Cue 的 [安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.8.0/docs/installation.md)操作。 簡繁文字取代仍需要為目前安裝的 Cue 開啟輔助使用權限；重新建置或更新可能 使舊授權失效。
最佳化檢查涵蓋核心換算邏輯、原生換算拷貝、匯率資料有效時間與取消行為、 鍵盤操作及搜尋學習。幣值服務測試使用注入的傳輸與隔離儲存；另一次實際連線 檢查成功下載服務商固定的美元匯率表。本機介面也確認了換算及 `it`／iTerm2 學習後的排序。這些檢查不代表完整的公開更新安裝流程或跨平台執行相容性 已驗證。
通用版目標為 **macOS 14+**，包含 Apple silicon 與 Intel 執行檔。實際執行驗證 環境為 **Apple silicon／macOS 27.0／Xcode 27**；Intel、其他 macOS 版本、另一台 Mac 的首次安裝，以及完整的公開更新安裝流程，仍未驗證。系統指令檢查使用 替代動作；本次發布尚未實際驗證睡眠、鎖定、關閉顯示器及登出／重開機後啟動 的完整循環。
